name: autocoder-nano
description: Lightweight CLI-based AI coding agent with code generation (/coding), AI chat (/chat), agent mode for automation (/auto), file management with context tracking, code indexing with RAG, rule engine for design patterns, and git integration. Supports multiple LLM providers.

name: aider-desk
description: Platform for AI-powered software engineers. Electron-based application that provides a workspace for AI-assisted development work.

name: Minuet AI
description: Emacs package providing code completion as-you-type from popular LLMs including OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Ollama, Llama.cpp, and Codestral. Integrates AI-powered code suggestions directly into Emacs editor.

name: ForeverVM
description: Secure sandbox environment for executing AI-generated code with persistent state. Sandboxes maintain context between sessions rather than being ephemeral, enabling continuous long-running code execution.

name: Illuvien
description: Drag-and-drop AI agent builder for visually constructing LLM workflows and deploying as APIs with one click. Graph-based editor with modular nodes, node-level debugging, performance evaluation, JSON-based configs, and support for multiple LLM providers.

name: Matter AI
description: Open-source AI code reviewer agent that analyzes pull requests and provides AI-powered insights through GitHub integration. Features include PR summaries, code review comments, code suggestions with patches, quality scoring, and security vulnerability detection.

name: OpenAI CodeAgent-action
description: GitHub Action that invokes OpenAI API as GenAI agent for CI/CD workflows. Uses AST analysis with prompt engineering for unit test generation, doc generation, CVE scanning, and code vulnerability detection without requiring fine-tuning or RAG.

name: project-handoffs
description: MCP server for maintaining persistence across AI coding agent sessions. Implements workflow chain (NextStep → WorkingSession → Handoff), organizes work by projects, uses priority levels, and tracks task history for context continuity.

name: BugOut
description: Local Pythonic coding agent that demonstrates building a local code-generation and execution agent from scratch. Uses locally running DeepSeek Lite API, implements streaming responses, maintains conversation history, and features iterative refinement with error re-injection.

name: QudeAI Framework
description: Open-source CLI framework for creating AI agents directly in terminal. Allows deploying custom AI agents to Solana blockchain, natural language interaction, real-time blockchain data analysis, and integration with Bitquery APIs.

name: ai_agents
description: Terminal task agent CLI for developers powered by NLP & AI. Helps organize and manage tasks through terminal with natural language processing.

name: ai.nvim
description: Neovim plugin integrating AI functionality directly into editor. Features quick change mode with :AiSuggestion for text replacement, chat interface with :AiChat for conversational AI with file references, and support for Google Gemini API.
